messages:
maria.g: Quick update — planning to add newton-4b v2 to the model catalog tomorrow 11:30 PT. Need owners for deployment steps, sanity checks, and rollback readiness.
vikram.s: I can take the deployment window 11:30-12:00 PT. Will perform the variant swap and monitor canary traffic.
chiara: I’ll own the quality gate — running evals & latency checks. I’ll post pass/fail within the first 10m.
sre_lead: I’ll reserve the quiet slot on infra and be ready to trigger rollback if errors > 0.5% or latency regression > 15%. Tagging rollback artifact as `newton4b-v2-rollback`.
alex.k: After canary, plan is to switch alias `catalog/newton` -> `newton4b-v2` if metrics green. If we see model drift on eval set, we revert alias and pin `newton4b-v1` explicitly.
maria.g: Awesome — quick checklist below. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you’re good.

- deploy owner: @vikram.s
- quality owner: @chiara
- infra/oncall: @sre_lead
- canary traffic: 5% for 8 minutes, then 25% for 7 minutes, ramp to 100% if green
- metrics to watch: request_error_rate, p95_latency, token_cost_delta, eval_regression_score
- rollback artifact: `newton4b-v2-rollback` pinned in registry

vikram.s: Commands I’ll run (sanity):
```
# create canary variant
redwood api deploy --model newton4b --version v2 --variant canary
# quick inference smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"newton4b-v2","prompt":"translate: Hello"}' | jq .
```
chiara: My quick acceptance tests (automated):
- run eval suite `evals/newton_regression` (10k samples quick subset)
- sample 100 production-like prompts for hallucination spot-check
- compare p95 latency to baseline (threshold: +15% allowed)

sre_lead: I’ll have the rollback playbook ready in the ops-runbook channel and a quick rollback command:
```
redwood api alias swap --alias catalog/newton --to newton4b-v1
```
alex.k: If all green, I’ll perform post-rollout pinning so the catalog version stays stable for 24h: `catalog.pin model=newton4b version=v2 duration=24h`
maria.g: Timing note — please be available 11:15–12:15 PT for prechecks and immediate follow-ups. If anyone can’t make it, call it out here.
vikram.s: I’ll set a calendar event and invite owners.
chiara: available. :thumbsup:
sre_lead: oncall OK — I’ll monitor logs + traces during ramp.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy-newton4b-v2` — will wait for manual start.
maria.g: Thanks team. I’ll post the final readiness ping 11:10 PT tomorrow and start the thread for the actual rollout. Keep alerts loud if anything odd. :rocket:
